lines.en: label nodokalibrary1:
scene nodokafirstlib1
I make my way to the library a bit later than I normally do and am immediately greeted by a rare sight.
lines.zh: 我今天去图书馆比平时晚了一点，立刻就被一幅罕见的景象迎接了。

lines.en: Sleeping on the job, Futaba? Really?
lines.zh: 上班时间睡觉，Futaba？真的？

lines.en: What if someone needs a book?
lines.zh: 万一有人需要借书呢？

lines.en: The world will spiral into chaos if you’re not there to check library cards and type names into your outdated computer.
lines.zh: 要是你不在那儿检查借书证、往你那台过时的电脑里敲名字，世界就要陷入混乱了。

lines.en: I take my phone out of my pocket and begin to file a formal complaint to the[school] when I hear a familiar voice call out to me.
lines.zh: 我从口袋里掏出手机，开始向 the[school] 提交一份正式投诉，这时我听见一个熟悉的声音在叫我。

lines.en: : Beautiful, isn’t she?...
lines.zh: : 很美，不是吗？……

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib2
: A wild Fukuyama, at rest in her natural habitat...entirely unaware that she is being studied by two of the most practiced researchers in all of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 一只野生 Fukuyama，在她的自然栖息地里安眠……浑然不觉自己正被全 Kumon-mi 经验最丰富的两位研究者观察着。

lines.en: : Indeed. Let us watch her closely and use this opportunity to educate future generations about her mannerisms and...tendencies or something.
lines.zh: : 确实。让我们仔细观察她，并利用这个机会来教育后代，讲讲她的习性以及……倾向之类的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Just throw some smart person lingo into the mix and assume I said that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。随便往里面掺点聪明人的行话，就当我是那么说的吧。

lines.en: : Educate future generations? Sensei, are you forgetting that we are here on a mission to discover the mating process of the wild Fukuyama?
lines.zh: : 教育后代？Sensei，你忘了我们来这儿的使命，是发现野生 Fukuyama 的交配过程吗？

lines.en: : Uhh, yes. I was definitely forgetting that.
lines.zh: : 呃，对。我确实是忘了。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib3
: Look at you, slacking off on our first day in the wilderness. Can you not tell when a creature is in heat simply by looking at them?
lines.zh: : 看看你，我们在野外的第一天就偷懒。你难道看一眼就看不出一只生物正处于发情期吗？

lines.en: : She just looks tired to me. But I’ll keep that in mind for when she wakes up. Have your camera ready.
lines.zh: : 我看她只是累了。不过等她醒的时候我会记住这点的。把你的相机准备好。

lines.en: : My camera is always ready, good sir.
lines.zh: : 我的相机时刻准备着，好先生。

lines.en: : In fact, why bother waiting at all? The Fukuyama is known for its love of copulating with fully-grown human males.
lines.zh: : 事实上，何必等呢？Fukuyama 以热爱与成年人类男性交媾而闻名。

lines.en: : Is there...a secret side of Futaba that I am unaware of?
lines.zh: : 难道说……Futaba 有什么我不知道的另一面？

lines.en: : Does the thought of her stripping down to her birthday suit and prancing around Kumon-mi in search of the ultimate satisfaction disturb you?
lines.zh: : 一想到她会脱个精光、在 Kumon-mi 里蹦蹦跳跳地寻找终极满足，你就觉得不安吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib4
: Hmm...Yes. Yes, that disturbs me as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是的。是的，我也觉得不安。

lines.en: : Return to the Jeep and grab the net. We shall capture this one and keep it as our personal specimen.
lines.zh: : 回吉普车去把网拿来。我们要把这一只抓起来，当作我们的私人标本。

lines.en: : Everyone wins.
lines.zh: : 大家都赢。

lines.en: : I just came from the Jeep and...I’m sorry to say, but it appears that we’ve forgotten our net, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我刚从吉普车那儿过来，而且……我很遗憾地说，看来我们忘带网了，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Well that’s no good at all. Without a net, we won’t be able to move into the second phase of any of our seven different strategies, Sensei. That net was extremely important.
lines.zh: : 那可一点也不妙。没有网，我们就无法进入七种策略中任何一种的第二阶段，Sensei。那张网极其重要。

lines.en: : Luckily, the Fukuyama is a predictable creature and can be found in this exact location every single weekend.
lines.zh: : 幸运的是，Fukuyama 是一种可预测的生物，每个周末都能在这个确切的位置找到。

lines.en: : So I suppose more opportunities will arise as long as we remain vigilant.
lines.zh: : 所以我想，只要我们保持警惕，机会还会再来的。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib5
: Now, what would you like to discuss with our daily quota of research out of the way?
lines.zh: : 那么，既然今天的调研配额已经用完了，你想聊点什么？

lines.en: : Anything, really.
lines.zh: : 真的什么都行。

lines.en: : I remember you mentioning that you’ll be spending some time here from now on, so...here I am, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我记得你提过，从现在开始会在这里待上一段时间，所以……我就来了，大概。

lines.en: : Did you miss me?
lines.zh: : 你想我了吗？

lines.en: : So much that I took up a job as a wildlife researcher just to get closer to you.
lines.zh: : 想得我都去当了野生动物研究员，只为能离你更近一点。

lines.en: : But you are my teacher...and I am your student. Think of how immoral this is, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 可你是我的老师……而我是你的学生。想想看这有多不道德啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : Nevermind how primally satisfying it would be to pin me down and take me on the desk of the teacher’s lounge.
lines.zh: : 更别提把我按在教师休息室的办公桌上要了我，会有多么原始而满足。

lines.en: : The teacher’s lounge actually doesn’t have any desks. It’s just couches.
lines.zh: : 教师休息室其实没有办公桌。只有沙发。

lines.en: : How unfortunate. I’ve always wanted to be taken on a[school] desk.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。我一直想在 a[school] 的书桌上被要。

lines.en: : If only we knew where to find any of those...
lines.zh: : 要是我们知道去哪儿找那些桌子就好了……

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib6
: Yes...if only.
lines.zh: : 是啊……要是就好了。

lines.en: Nodoka places her book down on the desk and I try to sneak a peek at whatever it is she’s been reading.
lines.zh: Nodoka 把她的书放到桌上，我试着偷瞄一眼她到底在读什么。

lines.en: I stop caring when I realize it isn’t anything pornographic. But I guess the chances are that she pulled whatever it was from one of the bookshelves here and...
lines.zh: 当我发现那不是什么色情读物的时候，我就不在意了。不过我猜那多半是她从这儿哪个书架上抽出来的，而且……

lines.en: Well, I don’t think this[school] carries much porn.
lines.zh: 嗯，我觉得 this[school] 应该不怎么藏色情书。

lines.en: I wonder if there is anything I can do that could change that?
lines.zh: 我在想，有没有什么我能做的事可以改变这一点？

lines.en: : Are you thinking what I’m thinking, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你在想我所想吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : You know, I really wouldn’t be surprised if I was.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，如果我真在想，我一点都不会惊讶。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib7
: Excellent. Then let us pick up where we left off before you ran away without saying goodbye the other night.
lines.zh: : 好极了。那么，就让我们从你那天晚上不告而别的地方接着来吧。

lines.en: Oh. I guess we weren’t thinking the same thing after all.
lines.zh: 哦。看来我们想的终究不是同一件事。

lines.en: : I believe I owe you an apology for making you feel uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 我想我欠你一个道歉，因为我让你感到不舒服了。

lines.en: : I got a little ahead of myself.
lines.zh: : 我有点操之过急了。

lines.en: : I’d like to say it won’t happen again, but saying that would make me a liar. And you seem to be the type to value honesty.
lines.zh: : 我想说我不会再这样了，但那么说我就成了骗子。而你似乎是那种看重诚实的人。

lines.en: : When it’s given to you, I mean. Not when you need to dish it out to others.
lines.zh: : 我是说，当诚实被给予你的时候。而不是当你要把诚实分给别人的时候。

lines.en: : That is surprisingly perceptive.
lines.zh: : 这洞察力意外地敏锐。

lines.en: : But yes, there’s not really any point in lying to me.
lines.zh: : 不过没错，对我撒谎确实没什么意义。

lines.en: : But there {i}was{/i} a point in lying to me about your...pure intentions. Was there not?
lines.zh: : 但对我撒谎说你那……纯洁的意图，{i}是{/i}有意义的吧？不是吗？

lines.en: : Why do you think I began to grill you so vigorously about the things you wanted to do to me within earshot of the others?
lines.zh: : 不然你以为我为什么要在别人听得见的地方，那么起劲地盘问你想对我做什么？

lines.en: : Because you’re weird and horny?
lines.zh: : 因为你又怪又饥渴？

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib8
: Wrong!
: I’m weird and horny {i}and{/i} a good girl who just wants to protect all of her companions.
lines.zh: : 我又怪又饥渴，{i}而且{/i}是个好女孩，只是想保护她所有的同伴。

lines.en: : Do you really think I’m leading any of them on or something?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我在吊着她们谁吗？

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib9
: I {i}think{/i} that a particular creature the two of us were sent here to study thinks that. And so I, too, must think that by association.
lines.zh: : 我{i}觉得{/i}，我们俩被派来研究的那个特定生物是这么想的。所以，出于连带关系，我也必须这么想。

lines.en: if futabalust10 == True:
Futaba did mention thinking something was going on between Chika and me at the Christmas party but...I’m pretty sure she’s not equating it to me leading her on, is she?
lines.zh: Futaba 确实提过，在圣诞派对上觉得我和 Chika 之间有点什么，但……我挺确定她不至于把这等同于我在吊着她，对吧？

lines.en: She just realizes that there are a lot of people who happen to be into me the same way she is.
lines.zh: 她只是意识到，有那么多人恰好跟她一样对我有意思。

lines.en: And she didn’t even seem that opposed to it when she told me...
lines.zh: 而且她跟我说这些的时候，甚至看起来并不那么反对……

lines.en: else:
Would Futaba really think something like that?...
lines.zh: Futaba 真的会那么想吗？……

lines.en: I mean, it would probably make sense if she did given how quickly things progressed between the two of us.
lines.zh: 我是说，考虑到我们俩之间的进展有多快，她会那么想也说得通。

lines.en: She’s a smart girl...so I get why she would feel that way.
lines.zh: 她是个聪明的女孩……所以我理解她为什么会有那种感觉。

lines.en: But to think those feelings were so apparent that even Nodoka would pick up on them...
lines.zh: 但没想到那份感情竟然明显到连 Nodoka 都察觉了……

lines.en: : You’re manipulating Futaba, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你在操控 Futaba，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s a little confusing seeing you ask that question with a smirk on your face.
lines.zh: : 看着你咧着嘴问出这个问题，真让人有点困惑。

lines.en: : Apologies. I have a natural smirk. I’m actually very upset with you if that’s what you're doing.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我天生就这副咧嘴样。如果你真在那么做，我其实非常生你的气。

lines.en: : I’m not telling you to drop everything you’re doing and devote yourself to her. She’s mine of course.
lines.zh: : 我不是要你放下手头的一切、全身心奉献给她。她当然是我的。

lines.en: : But she should at least know that she isn’t the only one you’re seeing.
lines.zh: : 但她至少应该知道，她不是你唯一在交往的人。

lines.en: if futabalust10 == True:
: I think she already {i}does{/i} know that, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得她{i}已经{/i}知道了。

lines.en: : She voiced her concerns about how one of the girls was acting around me during our Christmas party.
lines.zh: : 在我们的圣诞派对上，她说过她担心某个女孩在我身边的表现。

lines.en: : Which one? The tiny, black haired one in the back of the classroom?
lines.zh: : 哪个？坐在教室后面那个小小的、黑头发的？

lines.en: : ...Sana?
lines.zh: : ……Sana？

lines.en: : Why would you assume I was talking about Sana?
lines.zh: : 你为什么假设我说的是 Sana？

lines.en: : Because that would be the most exciting answer, obviously.
lines.zh: : 因为那显然是最让人兴奋的答案。

lines.en: : I mean, think about the size difference.
lines.zh: : 我是说，想想那体型差。

lines.en: : That’s definitely not the person Futaba was talking about.
lines.zh: : Futaba 说的绝对不是那个人。

lines.en: : But the point is that she’s perceptive enough to...understand the situation at hand here.
lines.zh: : 但重点是，她足够敏锐，能……理解眼下的状况。

lines.en: : So then why get mad at {i}me{/i} for asking what that situation was?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么因为{i}我{/i}问「那状况是什么」而生气？

lines.en: : All you had to do was come out and say, “I’m here to have sex with Nodoka and everyone else and there’s nothing anyone can do to stop me.”
lines.zh: : 你只要直说一句「我来这儿是为了跟 Nodoka 和其他所有人上床，谁也拦不住我」不就行了。

lines.en: else:
: Why does she need to know that?
lines.zh: : 她为什么需要知道那个？

lines.en: : Because she deals with enough bullshit from people commenting on her weight and demeanor.
lines.zh: : 因为她已经承受了够多狗屁——人们评论她的体重和举止。

lines.en: : I don’t want her to be slowly crushed by assuming the man she’s yearning for is only using her for her supple, youthful body.
lines.zh: : 我不希望她因为认定自己渴望的男人只是在利用她那柔软年轻的肉体，而被慢慢地压垮。

lines.en: : Not to turn the tables or anything, but why flirt with me so openly if you’re worried about her being hurt?
lines.zh: : 不是要反过来说你，但既然你担心她受伤，为什么还这么公开地跟我调情？

lines.en: : Obviously because {i}I’m{/i} in heat as well.
lines.zh: : 显然是因为{i}我{/i}也在发情期。

lines.en: : And when push comes to shove and I am forced to choose, I will obviously take care of myself before anyone else.
lines.zh: : 而到了紧要关头、被迫做出选择的时候，我显然会先照顾自己，再顾别人。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean I will simply abandon her in the springtime of her youth.
lines.zh: : 但这并不意味着我会在她青春的春天里就这么抛弃她。

lines.en: : This could have all been solved so easily by simply coming out and saying, “I’m here to have sex with Nodoka and everyone else and there’s nothing anyone can do to stop me.” the other night.
lines.zh: : 这一切本来可以轻易解决——只要那天晚上你直接说出那句「我来这儿是为了跟 Nodoka 和其他所有人上床，谁也拦不住我」。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s definitely not something that I think I’m ready to say yet.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这绝对还不是我现在准备好能说出口的话。

lines.en: : It’s true, though. Isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 可那是真的。不是吗？

lines.en: : Nodoka, as someone who appreciates girls as much as I do, I’m sure you understand.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，一个像我一样欣赏女孩的人，我相信你能理解。

lines.en: : Absolutely. There is not a body in that classroom that I don’t want all up in my business.
lines.zh: : 当然。那间教室里没有一具身体是我不想让它掺和进我的事的。

lines.en: : But I’m not pushing all of them into different rooms and asking that they keep their schedules open while I take turns individually dishing out orgasms.
lines.zh: : 但我没有把她们一个个推进不同的房间、要求她们把日程空出来，好让我轮流给她们高潮。

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib10
: I’m not going to say anything.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不会说的。

lines.en: : Frankly, I only care about two people out of seventeen right now after excluding myself from the count.
lines.zh: : 坦白说，把自己从计数里排除之后，十七个人里我现在只在乎两个。

lines.en: : Two? Weren’t you starting to get close to Rin, though?
lines.zh: : 两个？你不是开始跟 Rin 走得挺近了吗？

lines.en: : Her company is fun and she is a nice girl. But that doesn’t mean I care enough about her to prioritize her in any way.
lines.zh: : 跟她相处很开心，她也是个好女孩。但这不意味着我在乎她到会优先考虑她的程度。

lines.en: : I make people work to get on my good side. That way, they’re less inclined to abandon me and leave me with nothing.
lines.zh: : 我让别的人努力才能进入我的好感区。这样，她们就不太会抛弃我、让我一无所有。

lines.en: : I feel like {i}I{/i} didn’t have to work very hard to get on your good side.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}觉得我没怎么费劲就进入了你的好感区。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib11
: You think you’re on my good side?
lines.zh: : 你觉得自己进入了我的好感区？

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : What gives you that idea?
lines.zh: : 什么让你有那种想法？

lines.en: : The fact that you’re slowly but surely showing me some cracks in your armor.
lines.zh: : 你正缓慢而确实地向我露出盔甲上的一些裂缝。

lines.en: : Cracks are just cracks, Sensei. They’re not really weak points until you bash or stab them a few more times.
lines.zh: : 裂缝就只是裂缝，Sensei。除非你再多砸几下、多捅几下，它们才算得上是真正的弱点。

lines.en: : If you really want to get my armor off, all you need to do is save up enough Nodoka points.
lines.zh: : 如果你真想脱掉我的盔甲，你只需要攒够 Nodoka 点数。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, you missed out on a large sum of them by not eating my pizza the other night.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是，那天晚上你没吃我的披萨，错过了一大笔点数。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure it wasn’t, but I’m going to interpret “eating my pizza” as a euphemism.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定不是那个意思，不过我打算把「吃我的披萨」理解成一个委婉说法。

lines.en: : Do it. That makes the idea of the four girls who remained upstairs eating pizza all night significantly more exciting.
lines.zh: : 就这么理解吧。这样一想，留在楼上吃了一整晚披萨的那四个女孩，就变得有意思多了。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib12
: And say goodbye for real next time. Making me have to wait to apologize was a real cliffhanger.
lines.zh: : 还有，下次要真的说再见。让我等着才能道歉，真是个要命的悬念。

lines.en: : I figured someone as well-read as you would {i}like{/i} cliffhangers.
lines.zh: : 我以为像你这样博览群书的人会{i}喜欢{/i}悬念。

lines.en: : Not when they involve me.
lines.zh: : 当悬念牵扯到我的时候就不喜欢。

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib13
: Which is why I’m taking countermeasures to prevent that from ever happening again.
lines.zh: : 所以我正在采取对策，防止这种事再次发生。

lines.en: : Countermeasures? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 对策？你在说什么？

lines.en: scene nodokafirstlib14
: Take down my number and let me bother you whenever I want to procrastinate or apologize for more things I’m going to do in the future.
lines.zh: : 记下我的号码，这样我什么时候想拖延时间、或者为以后还要做的更多事情道歉，都能来烦你。

lines.en: : Just how difficult are you planning on making my life?
lines.zh: : 你到底打算把我的生活搞得多难？

lines.en: : As difficult as I can make it without entering into a formal relationship with you.
lines.zh: : 在不跟你正式交往的前提下，能有多难就多难。

lines.en: : Wow. Are you rejecting me before I’ve even asked you out?
lines.zh: : 哇。你这是在我还没开口约你之前就拒绝我吗？

lines.en: : A - You will never ask me out without some serious character development on your end.
lines.zh: : A——除非你在性格上有相当大的成长，否则你永远不会约我出去。

lines.en: : B - I have to keep myself open for when Futaba becomes a lesbian.
lines.zh: : B——我得给自己留着机会，等 Futaba 变成同性恋的那天。

lines.en: : It’s unfair that you get to play with her breasts recreationally and I have to do it by force.
lines.zh: : 你能把玩她的胸部当消遣，而我却得用强的，这太不公平了。

lines.en: : I want to say you should probably stop doing that, but I enjoy the mental image of it, so feel free to continue.
lines.zh: : 我想说我大概该劝你别再那么做了，但我挺享受那个画面，所以随便你继续。

lines.en: : I will do just that.
lines.zh: : 我会的。

lines.en: : Oh, and Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，Sensei？

lines.en: : Hm?
: You {i}are{/i} on my good side.
lines.zh: : 你{i}在{/i}我的好感区里。

lines.en: : My distaste for cliffhangers compelled me to let you know that before you wander off to flirt with someone else.
lines.zh: : 我对悬念的反感，促使我在你走开去跟别人调情之前让你知道这一点。

lines.en: : Funny story, I’m about to do that right now.
lines.zh: : 巧了，我正要去做这件事。

lines.en: : I’ll be thinking of you the entire way there, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我一路走过去都会想着你的。

lines.en: : And I’ll be watching you very closely as you walk away.
lines.zh: : 而在你走开的时候，我会非常仔细地看着你。

lines.en: : You have an excellent figure for someone your age.
lines.zh: : 以你这个年纪的人来说，你的身材好极了。

lines.en: : I’m not even that old...
lines.zh: : 我又没那么老……

lines.en: scene black
I quickly exchange numbers with Nodoka and slide my phone back into my pocket.
lines.zh: 我迅速和 Nodoka 交换了号码，把手机滑回口袋。

lines.en: As I leave the library, I feel the looming gaze of a perverted, semi-sociopath on my back.
lines.zh: 离开图书馆时，我感觉到背上落着一道变态、半反社会者的逼人的目光。

lines.en: Just seconds after turning the corner, a noise leaks out of my pocket and the relationship I have with Nodoka grows even stranger.
lines.zh: 拐过街角才几秒钟，口袋里漏出一阵声响，而我和 Nodoka 的关系变得更加奇怪了。

lines.en: {i}Nodoka has sent you a picture message!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Nodoka 给你发了一条图片消息！{/i}

lines.en: $ nodokanumber = True
$ nodoka_love += 1
$ nodokalibrary1 = True
{i}Nodoka’s affection has increased to [nodoka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Nodoka 的好感度提升到了 [nodoka_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
